content.what_it_is: FUNWAVE-GPU(CUDA Fortran 판, dryuanye/FUNWAVE-GPU, FUNWAVE-TVD v3.3 이식, Yuan 2020 JAMES) 전수분석 노트 — GPU 전용 *_gpu.F 8파일+mod_cuda.F를 전수 read(L5·L12), 비-gpu 파일은 CPU판 공유. §1 mod_cuda.F(451줄, L14-L17): use cudafor+use cusparse; 변수 TriSolver(0=Thomas/1=cuSPARSE)·streamID(8)+stream_d2h·cusparseh·gtsv_buf+gtsv_bufsize·BlockDim*_2D=16/_Inner_2D=14(타일+halo 2)·constant memory(Beta_ref_d·alpha_d(3)·beta_d(3) RK계수·n_left/right/bottom/top_d 경계법선)·~100개 _d device 배열; subr var_d2h_output(:171)·ESTIMATE_DT_GPU(:225, !$cuf kernel do(2)+MPI_ALLREDUCE)·cusparse_init(:348)/cusparse_destroy(:358)·cudadeviceQuery(:301). §2 init_gpu.F(596줄, L19-L24): AssignDevice(:25, MGPU, cudaSetDevice·MPI_COMM_SPLIT_TYPE SHARED)·CudaMemUse(:55, cudaMemGetInfo 80%↑ 경고)·stream_init(:92, cudaStreamCreate ×8+d2h)·ALLOCATE_VARIABLES_GPU(:112, ~80 _d allocate)·INITIALIZATION_GPU(:267, 암묵 cudaMemcpy host→device+WaveMaker 문자열→정수 WaveMakerCode 변환(GPU 커널 char 불가)+TriSolver==1이면 cusparse_init). §3 etauv_solver_gpu.F(2019줄, L26-L41): ESTIMATE_HUV_GPU(ISTEP)(:86)가 ①HUV_BAR_KERNEL ②TriSolver별 tridiagonal ③post_tridiagonal_kernel(Froude cap·HU/HV); attributes(global) 커널 — HUV_BAR_KERNEL(:1204, MUSCL-Hancock flux 발산 RK, alpha_d/beta_d(ISTEP) constant), triDx_init_kernel(:1427)/triDy_init_kernel(:1589, 계수 Γ₁·MASK9_d·dep²·DX²), triDx_cusparse_init_kernel(:1502)/triDy_cusparse_init_kernel(:1683, 1D 평면화 RowIndex=(i−NGhost)+(j−NGhost−1)(Mloc−2NGhost)), transpose_kernel(:1955), post_tridiagonal_kernel(:1975); 솔버 2경로 — TriSolver==0 Thomas: triDx_triDy_cuda(:565, transpose→triDx_cuda_kernel(streamID2)+triDy_cuda_kernel(streamID3, 행/열=1스레드)→deviceSync→역transpose); TriSolver==1 cuSPARSE: triDx_cusparse(:897)/triDy_cusparse(:933, bufferSizeExt→cusparseSgtsv2StridedBatch(m=Mloc−2NGhost, batchCount=Nloc−2NGhost, batchStride=Mloc−2NGhost, gtsv_buf)), CPU TRIDx J루프 직렬을 전 행 batch 동시로; MGPU: triDxDy_mgpu_cuda_v1(:183)·_v2(:321)·periodic_triDx_triDy_cuda(:597 Sherman-Morrison)·triD{x,y}_mgpu_cuda(cudaMemcpy2dAsync D2H→MPI→H2D); Blackwell 포팅(cusparseSgtsvStridedBatch CUDA12 제거→v2, L41). §4 exchange_gpu.F(1853줄, module boundary_condition_module, L43-L48): BOUNDARY_CONDITION_FLUXES_GPU(:152, X/Y kernel streamID2/3)·EXCHANGE_GPU(:800, PHI_COLL_GPU+!$cuf U_d*=MASK_d)·PHI_COLL_GPU(:967, 6 VTYPE ghost, !$cuf kernel do(2) <<<*,(4,64)>>> NGhost=3 얇은 x 최적 block, MGPU cudaMemcpy2D+MPI_SENDRECV, phi_exch_cuda)·EXCHANGE_DISPERSION_GPU(:340, 분산 ~20 미분필드 다물리량 단일커널로 launch 오버헤드 절감)·periodic_NSexchange_gpu(:1597, 남북주기 단일 D2D/MGPU D2H+MPI+H2D). §5 물리 커널(L50-L54): breaker_gpu.F(309줄) breaking_kernel(:128, Kennedy eddy viscosity, shared Age_sh(:140)+syncthreads로 4분면 전파 race 제거, Inner 14×14); masks_gpu.F(179줄) update_mask9_kernel(:98, MASK9 9점곱 shared MASK_sh)·update_mask_kernel(:21 flood/dry)·UPDATE_MASK_GPU(:127, MGPU phi_int_exch_cuda); mixing_gpu.F(153줄) calc_sum_kernel(:61)/calc_mean_kernel(:33, 시간평균·Eta0_d zero-upcrossing 파고)·MIXING_STUFF_GPU(:143, STEADY_TIME 후); sponge_gpu.F(44줄) sponge_damping_kernel(:18, LD Eta_d/SPONGE_d, MASK_d>0만, in-place). §6 CPU vs GPU 차이 표(L56-L67): tridiagonal(직렬 Thomas↔병렬 Thomas/cuSPARSE batched), halo(배열복사↔!$cuf·cudaMemcpy2D+MPI), 쇄파 AGE(직접덮어↔shared AGE0_d), DT(단일루프 min↔!$cuf reduction+MPI_ALLREDUCE), WaveMaker(character↔정수 WaveMakerCode), x-Thomas(—↔transpose_kernel); CUDA 요소 요약(L67). §7 연결(L69-L70): build-and-blackwell-port·dispersion-solver·code-graph.

verbatim_spans.text: > FUNWAVE-TVD v3.3의 multi-GPU 이식 (dryuanye/FUNWAVE-GPU, Yuan 2020 JAMES).
`INITIALIZATION_GPU`(:267): host→device 복사(`Eta_d=Eta` 암묵 cudaMemcpy) + **WaveMaker 문자열→정수 WaveMakerCode**(GPU 커널 char 불가) + TriSolver==1이면 cusparse_init
- `PHI_COLL_GPU`(:967): 6 VTYPE ghost, `!$cuf kernel do(2) <<<*,(4,64)>>>`(NGhost=3 얇은 x에 최적 block), MGPU `cudaMemcpy2D`+`MPI_SENDRECV`, `phi_exch_cuda`
- **breaker_gpu.F**(309) `breaking_kernel`(:128): Kennedy eddy viscosity. ★**shared memory** `Age_sh`(:140) — AGE_BREAKING0_d(이전스텝) 로드+`syncthreads()`로 4분면 전파 race 제거(CPU는 직접덮어 순서의존). Inner 14×14
